name: @pipeworx/mcp-stratz

tools.name: graphql
tools.description: Send an arbitrary GraphQL query (with optional variables) directly to the STRATZ API at api.stratz.com/graphql. Use when no named tool covers the data you need. Field names are camelCase and must match the STRATZ schema exactly (e.g. numLastHits, goldPerMinute, constants { gameModes }); a query naming an unknown field fails with "Cannot query field", so introspect the type (`{ __type(name: "MatchPlayerType") { fields { name } } }`) before guessing. Requires a STRATZ Bearer token.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: hero
tools.description: Fetch a single Dota 2 hero's full detail by numeric hero id — display name, short name, roles, and base/gain stats (armor, strength, agility, intelligence, primary attribute, attack type/range/rate, starting damage, move speed, vision range).

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: heroes
tools.description: Fetch the complete list of all Dota 2 heroes from STRATZ, returning each hero's numeric id, name, displayName, and shortName. No arguments required.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: hero_stats
tools.description: Fetch daily win-rate and pick-rate statistics for a Dota 2 hero by numeric hero_id, optionally filtered to a rank bracket (e.g. HERALD, ARCHON, LEGEND, DIVINE, IMMORTAL). Returns matchCount and winCount per day.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: match
tools.description: Fetch full details of a single Dota 2 match by numeric match id — duration, start time, Radiant/Dire teams, game mode, lobby type, and per-player stats (heroId, K/D/A, GPM, XPM, level).

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: player
tools.description: Fetch a Dota 2 player's profile by Steam account id — Steam name, profile URL, avatar, total match count, and win count via STRATZ.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: player_matches
tools.description: Fetch a Dota 2 player's recent match history by Steam account id. Returns one row per match: match id, duration, start time, game mode, Radiant win flag, plus this player's heroId, side, win/loss, K/D/A, last hits, GPM/XPM, level and IMP. Supports pagination via take/skip.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: player_heroes
tools.description: Fetch the top heroes played by a Dota 2 player (by Steam account id), ranked by match count — returns heroId, matchCount, and winCount for up to `take` heroes (default 20).

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: live_matches
tools.description: Fetch all currently live Dota 2 matches from STRATZ, returning matchId, radiantTeamId, direTeamId, and current game time. No arguments required.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: tournament
tools.description: Fetch details for a single Dota 2 tournament (league) by numeric id — display name, description, tier, start/end dates, and prize pool.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: tournaments
tools.description: List Dota 2 tournaments (leagues) from STRATZ, most recent start date first (up to 50) — id, name, tier, start/end dates and prize pool. Pass only_premium=true to restrict to MAJOR and INTERNATIONAL tier events.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

tools.name: meta
tools.description: Fetch current Dota 2 meta constants from STRATZ: the list of game versions (patches) with their id and name. No arguments required.

_apiKey.description: Your own STRATZ API token (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at https://stratz.com/api after Steam sign-in.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-stratz forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the stratz pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
